title: Screen P112 tetrad coefficient fusion under relaxed rank ceilings
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This source-bound P112 follow-up composes tetrad coefficient fusion through the selected centre consumer. In each of the 14 tetrads, the same four product values produce both the fused port update and the source-side dirty correction:
`M E^T = U K`, `J = (C^T M) E^T`, and `S^T(d + U K x) - Jx = S^T(d + Kx)`. The identity holds for an arbitrary dirty baseline `d`; it does not provide a native schedule or free scalar work.

Binding the eight centre outputs to the selected native frames gives the unique minimum slot map `[7,5,4,6,3,1,0,2]`. All 56 augmented terms have support-pair rank one. The bounded screen checks 784 valid completions and 18,816 elementary shears; every tested shear preserves that factorization. Minimum centre support is 76 coefficients, compared with 88 for standard-row complements and 92 for the original completion.

Charging one rank-one unit per centre coefficient gives a best tested local cost of 132, above the 112-copy control. The ideal two-unpaid complex profile `{1:324, 32:166}` has local mass 5,636 and conditional ceiling `κ = 0.0134440084459`, below the `0.0137876681081` baseline. This is a sensitivity ceiling, not a physical invoice or admitted supplier. The dirty-state lifetime, native term schedule, scalar tariff, bit-side endpoint contract and complete joint invoice remain open. Selected κ remains `0.001672660197076918`; no frontier change or κ improvement is claimed. The consumer endpoint changed, while the original P112 COPY112 floor is unaffected.

## Task and overlap

Task card `coverage-law-change`, priority revision 6; scope refined to source-bound co-delivery and a finite completion/shear sensitivity screen. The package is based on `9a56309846c262238de04138d14d8bc32ec83d77`; exact source blobs and hashes are recorded in `research/p112-centre-co-delivery/SOURCES.json`. The scope change follows the preceding consumer audit, which identified the source-side correction but did not show how it could share the tetrad products.

This extends [PR #3566](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3566)'s selected-port binding and [PR #3567](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3567)'s tetrad-local rank screen through the selected centre consumer. It also retains the dirty-state correction audit from this PR's earlier work. The cached overlap scan covered 394 PRs and 2,319 discussions as of 2026-10-18 03:15 UTC; its refresh failed, so it is not a novelty certificate.

## Validation

Reproduce from the repository root with Python 3.12:

```sh
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-centre-co-delivery --check-only
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-centre-co-delivery
```

The registered replay checks all 14 co-delivery identities, native-label complements, all 40,320 slot assignments, 784 completions, 18,816 shears, support-rank profiles and the conditional complex ceiling. It does not certify a native COPY schedule, physical scalar tariff, supplier admission, complete joint invoice, selected cold replay or a multiplication theorem.

## Credit

The P112 root geometry and local decoder retain the attribution in `research/p112-tetrad-local-decoder/`. The selected-port bijection comes from PR #3566; the native centre-role/frame binding retains `research/selected-centre-native-lift/` and its predecessors. This follow-up adds the co-delivery factorization and bounded completion/shear census. Prepared by Gonzalo Mier with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

1. Can one augmented tetrad term family be implemented as a chronological native COPY program on arbitrary dirty ports and centre channels? Bind its source forms, outputs, adapters, dirty inputs, scratch lifetimes and restoration, and price every scalar operation.
2. Can both selected suppliers justify two unpaid coordinates under that complete endpoint contract? Replay the exact full-call coverage identity on both sides, including co-delivered centre outputs and restoration. The bit-side premise and joint endpoint remain unadmitted.
